start.text: Call no more than 10 working days before work starts.

trench.text: Federal OSHA covers private crews here: protective system from 5 ft (29 CFR 1926.652).

states.name: Utah

notice.text: Give notice at least 48 hours (business days) and not more than 14 days before digging. The clock starts 8 AM the next business day.

start.text: Give notice no more than 14 days before work starts.

life.text: A ticket is good for 21 days from the day notice was given. New tickets expire at 8 AM on day 21.

states.renew: Renew at least 48 hours and no sooner than 7 days before day 21. A renewal adds 21 days from the old expiry.
states.tol_text: 24 inches either side of the facility mark (or half the marked diameter plus 24 inches from center).
states.white_text: If the site can’t be described, outline it using the uniform color code.
states.emergency: The notice rule does not apply in an emergency.

trench.text: UOSH adopts the federal rule: protective system from 5 ft (29 CFR 1926.652).

states.name: Vermont

notice.text: Call at least 72 hours before digging, not counting weekends and holidays.

life.text: Tickets expire 30 days from the day they are issued.

states.renew: Renew only if work will happen within 30 days.
states.tol_text: The facility width plus 18 inches each side.
states.white_text: Premark the dig area in white before you call (digs over 500 ft are exempt).
states.emergency: Emergency notice the same day.

trench.text: State OSHA plan. Federal OSHA’s 5 ft rule is the floor; we have not checked whether this plan is stricter.

states.name: Virginia

life.text: A notice is good for 15 working days from 7 AM the next working day (or the scheduled date if later).

states.renew: Ask for a remark 3 working days before the end, or when marks fade. A remark adds 15 working days.
states.white_text: Mark the route or site with white paint when a location can’t be given.

trench.text: State OSHA plan. Federal OSHA’s 5 ft rule is the floor; we have not checked whether this plan is stricter.

states.note: Virginia: dig only after every operator has marked or posted a positive response.

states.name: Washington

notice.text: Call at least 2 full business days and not more than 10 full business days before digging. From Jan 1, 2026, wait for a positive response from every operator.

start.text: Call no more than 10 full business days before work starts.

life.text: Marks are good for 45 calendar days from the day you gave notice.

states.renew: Past 45 days, give a new notice.
states.tol_text: Marks are accurate to within 24 inches of each side of the facility.
states.white_text: Mark the dig area with white lining or white pin flags before you call.
states.emergency: Emergency: clear and present danger to life, health or property, or an unplanned outage with a crew on site or on the way.

trench.text: Washington DOSH: protective system from 4 ft unless the competent person finds no cave-in hazard, or it is all stable rock (WAC 296-155-657). From June 1, 2026: a written trench work plan when a protective system is needed, and a competent person on site during trench work.

states.name: West Virginia

notice.text: Give notice at least 48 hours (not weekends or holidays) and not more than 10 work days before digging.

start.text: Give notice no more than 10 work days before work starts.

states.emergency: A break or leak that causes an emergency: call 911 right away.

trench.text: Federal OSHA covers private crews here: protective system from 5 ft (29 CFR 1926.652).

states.name: Wisconsin

notice.text: Give notice at least 3 working days before digging.

states.renew: No set ticket life. Give a new notice if marks are lost, or work doesn’t start within 10 days of the scheduled start, or stops more than 10 days.
states.tol_text: Keep 18 inches between a mark and the machine’s cutting edge.
states.emergency: In an emergency, take all reasonable care and notify owners as soon as you can.

trench.text: Federal OSHA covers private crews here: protective system from 5 ft (29 CFR 1926.652).

states.name: Wyoming

notice.text: Call at least 2 full business days and not more than 14 business days before digging.

start.text: Call no more than 14 business days before work starts.

life.text: For longer jobs, renew the notice at least once every 14 business days.

states.renew: Renew every 14 business days.
states.tol_text: Marks within 24 inches of the facility.
states.emergency: Emergency digging is exempt from the time limits.

trench.text: State OSHA plan. Federal OSHA’s 5 ft rule is the floor; we have not checked whether this plan is stricter.
